answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 36235 Country: India Title: Please send me boy and girl names with meaning provided the first latter starts from F or S. Question: Please send me boy and girl names with meaning provided the first latter starts from F or S. Please help me to find some good names. Answer ID: 36235 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 243/138/D=1433) Names for boys: Saeed, Sa'ad, Sajid, Farooque, Faheem Names for girls: Fatimah, Fahmidah, Sajidah, Saudah Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
